fact: Before Cameroon adopted its digital health strategy in January 2020, a clinical information system on the open-source MediBoard was deployed for outpatient consultations at the maternity of Yaoundé Central Hospital, a national referral hospital, with data entered on computers in consultation rooms alongside paper service registers; at six months it held 1,278 patient records from 113 users, and users stopped entering data when the documentation payment ended, the second part never being funded.
title: Implementing Clinical Information Systems in Sub-Saharan Africa: Report and Lessons Learned From the MatLook Project in Cameroon
